spanish: Y no vomite la tierra a ustedes en su contaminar a ustedes a ella, conforme a lo que vomitó a la nación que delante de ustedes.

findings.issue: The 2mp suffix on the piel infinitive is the subject (you defile her). 'su contaminar a ustedes a ella' makes ustedes an object of contaminar along with the 3fs object.
findings.spanishSpan: su contaminar a ustedes a ella

findings.issue: לֹא plus hiphil imperfect licenses 'will not vomit'; subjunctive 'vomite' reads as a wish that it not vomit.
כַּאֲשֶׁר introduces the clause 'as she vomited the nation'. 'conforme a lo que' can make 'lo que' a second object or the subject beside that nation.
'delante de' smooths the preposition plus plural noun 'faces' into a bare preposition; 'before you' remains.

notes: Y, la tierra, a ustedes as object of vomite, a ella, singular la nación, and qal vomitó match the tokens.
